items.title: Congress Recess Plans Throws Another Roadblock Up for  Crypto Bill
items.summary: House members are going home early to campaign, giving them less time to consider a bill that would take most crypto trading out of the purview of securities laws.

items.title: Hunter Biden Called Trump’s Crypto Empire “Corruption at a Scale We’ve Never Seen.” Now He’s Launching His Own Memecoin.
items.summary: Weeks after calling the Trump family's crypto venture a historic corruption scandal, Hunter Biden announced his own memecoin complete with a burn mechanism tied to the 2028 election. His motive is unusually candid, and the token economics raise questions worth examining before the September 9 launch.

items.title: CLARITY Act Is a 'Powerful Package' Ahead of Key Vote Next Week, Coinbase Exec Says
items.summary: The U.S. crypto industry faces its biggest legislative test yet on Sept. 15, when the Senate is scheduled to hold a crucial procedural vote on the CLARITY Act. Why Shirzad Sees Two Outcomes Speaking with industry advocate Scott Melker on...

items.title: Zcash Crossed $1,000 Two Weeks After Grayscale’s ETF Launched. Is Privacy the New Institutional Trade?
items.summary: Grayscale just handed institutional investors a brokerage-account way to buy the coin regulators spent years trying to block, and the price response raised a question nobody in crypto expected to be asking this soon.

items.title: Strategy Didn’t Touch Bitcoin Last Week After Making First Purchase Since June
items.summary: Strategy doesn’t sell or purchase any Bitcoin last week. The stock is falling as Bitcoin prices retreat.

items.title: MSTR, COIN, CRCL Stocks Dip: Crypto Equities Pull Back After Bitcoin's $82K Rejection
items.summary: Ethereum outperformed Bitcoin over the past 24 hours, helping shares of ETH treasury company BitMine Immersion Technologies edge higher in premarket trading.

items.title: Bitcoin Rally Faces Fresh Risks From Fed, Oil, Yen And Bond Markets As Spot Demand Weakens
items.summary: Bitcoin's correlation with gold is at a six-year high, according to Bitwise, suggesting investors are using it as a hedge against U.S. fiscal threats.

items.title: Hunter Biden (and His Laptop) Enter the Cryptosphere With New Meme Coin
items.summary: The son of former President  Joe Biden  is launching a meme coin that takes aim at his family’s nemesis,  Donald Trump.  Yes,  Hunter Biden’s  laptop will live on.  Biden’s token will trade under the ticker, $LAPTOP, and launch Sept. 9 on Base, a digital ledger built by  Coinbase Global  the largest U.S. crypto exchange, people familiar with the matter said.
